reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and unlinking shares clearBankLink, but transaction downloading copies the existing Akahu implementation.

duplication.why: The Fintegra downloader duplicates Akahu's request, error handling and response mapping, and the tests introduce two equivalent row-count helpers.

placement.why: Link policies, transaction downloading, server configuration and provider types remain in their established modules and layers.

scope.why: The changes support the requested linking policies and provider integration, apart from an unrelated schedule import reorder.

maintainability.why: Shared link preparation and link clearing keep the policies maintainable, although the copied downloader adds another implementation to maintain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link handlers use prepareBankAccountLink and linkBankSyncAccount, and Fintegra uses the existing bank-selection helper.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions with provider substitutions and reshapes the response-variable initialization without sharing the logic.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink adds one requested policy flag to the shared linking parameters; preparation remains provider-independent and every provider calls it.
